feed_rate_kg_d.owner: AQS-ASSAY-001 Rev C design feed rate (owner basis)

feed_case_A_silicate_oxide.owner: AQS-ASSAY-001 Rev C class A (regolith-like) point
feed_case_A_silicate_oxide.verification_test: XRF/XRD assay of a representative class A lot

case_A_oxide_fractions.verification_test: XRF major-oxide analysis of the accepted feed

case_A_leach_extent.verification_test: Bench leach of class A feed in HCl at 85 C, ICP-OES of liquor for Al, Ca, Mg, Fe extraction

acid_conc_design_wt.verification_test: Conventional EDBM is limited to about 3.6 M acid (EDBM_WHEY_2021); 20 wt% (about 6 M) needs a concentration step or a lower loop concentration; bench EDBM run on the leach brine

bmed_sec_kWh_per_kg_base.verification_test: EDBM pilot on the plant chloride brine: SEC and current efficiency at the design product concentration

bmed_sec_design_kWh_per_kg_pair.units: kWh per kg acid+base (current graph basis)
bmed_sec_design_kWh_per_kg_pair.verification_test: Superseded by bmed_sec_kWh_per_kg_base once the loop concentration is fixed
bmed_sec_design_kWh_per_kg_pair.published: EDBM_PILOT_2023 1.4-2.6 kWh/kg NaOH at 0.5-1 M; EDBM_WHEY_2021 6.7 kWh/kg at 2 M

ew_current_efficiency_design.verification_test: Bench chloride EW cell per metal: deposit mass vs charge (current efficiency)

ew_cell_voltage_V.verification_test: Bench chloride EW cell polarisation at 200 A/m2 with MMO anode
ew_cell_voltage_V.published: SCHLESINGER2011 about 2.0 V for Cu sulfate EW

cp_hcl20_kJ_kgK.verification_test: Check against the Perry sec. 2 aqueous HCl heat-capacity table at 20 wt% and 60 C

cp_naoh20_kJ_kgK.verification_test: Check against the Perry sec. 2 aqueous NaOH heat-capacity table at 20 wt% and 60 C

U_free_convection_W_m2K.verification_test: Coil outlet temperature on the installed air cooler

slurry_min_DN.verification_test: Deposition-velocity check of each slurry line at its solids loading (Durand/Wilson correlation) and a flow-loop trial with the plant solids
